english.title: Employer provide respiratory equipment other than in accordance with asbestos regulations
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an employer, provided personal protective equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT..) in accordance with regulation

(A)_[11]_
(B)_[14(1)]_

of the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012, which was not suitable for its purpose and did not comply with the applicable provision of the Personal Protective Equipment Regulations 2002, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROVISION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 11(4)(a) of the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 and section 33(1)(c) of, and Schedule 3A to, the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.

english.notes: These Regulations apply to any work outside Great Britain to which sections 1 to 59 and 80 to 82 of the Health and Safety at Work Act etc 1974 Act apply by virtue of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974 (Application Outside Great Britain) Order 2001 as they apply to work in Great Britain.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Note: In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (general limit on magistrates' court's powers to imprison), a reference to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months is to be read as a reference to imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months.
